segments.thag13.1:1.1: “Yāhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho, rañño aṅgassa paddhagū [patthagū (syā.), paṭṭhagū (ka.)];
segments.thag13.1:1.3: Svājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho, soṇo dukkhassa pāragū.
segments.thag13.1:2.1: “Pañca chinde pañca jahe, pañca cuttari bhāvaye;
segments.thag13.1:3.3: Sīlaṃ samādhi paññā ca, pāripūriṃ na gacchati.
segments.thag13.1:4.1: “Yañhi kiccaṃ apaviddhaṃ [tadapaviddhaṃ (sī. syā.)], akiccaṃ pana karīyati;
segments.thag13.1:5.3: Akiccaṃ te na sevanti, kicce sātaccakārino;
segments.thag13.1:7.3: Vīṇopamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā;
segments.thag13.1:7.5: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.
segments.thag13.1:8.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thag13.1:9.1: “Nekkhamme [nikkhame (ka.), nekkhammaṃ (mahāva.244; a. ni.6.55)] adhimuttassa, pavivekañca cetaso;
segments.thag13.1:11.3: Katassa paṭicayo natthi, karaṇīyaṃ na vijjati.
segments.thag13.1:12.3: Evaṃ rūpā rasā saddā, gandhā phassā ca kevalā.

lines: “Tassa sammā vimuttassā”tiādīsu ayaṃ saṅkhepattho – tassa vuttanayena sammadeva sabbasaṃkilesato vimuttassa, tato eva accantupasamena santacittassa khīṇāsavabhikkhuno katassa kusalassa akusalassa vā upacayo natthi maggeneva samugghātitattā, pariññādibhedaṃ karaṇīyaṃ na vijjati katakiccattā.

Evaṃ bhūtassa yathā ekaghano selo pabbato pakativātena na samīrati na saṃkampati, evaṃ iṭṭhā ca aniṭṭhā ca rūpādayo ārammaṇadhammā tādino tādibhāvappattassa ṭhitaṃ anejaṃ pahīnasabbasokatāya visaṃyuttaṃ cittaṃ nappavedhanti na cālenti.
Assa ca ārammaṇadhammassa kālena kālaṃ phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā vipassanto vayaṃ nirodhaṃ khaṇe khaṇe bhijjanasabhāvaṃ anupassatīti aññaṃ byākāsi.
